timeline.text: Founded as Mate Clove Sdn Bhd on 17 July 2020.
Pivot into pineapple, from Sri Kembangan, with a contract network of about 180 acres.
The network expands, with first steps into South Korea.
The CPPC opens at Labu Lanjut, Sepang. Own SG1 farm in Pontian, Johor.
Renamed Agrionyx Group. 600+ acres in the network, IQF processing. Buavia launches in December.

vision: To build a globally connected agribusiness group that transforms agriculture into an integrated, scalable and sustainable ecosystem creating lasting value for people, industry and nature.
mission: To connect every critical part of the agricultural value chain from farm to global market through integration, technology, knowledge and strong commercial partnerships.
purpose: To Make Life Better Through Agriculture.

values.name: Connecting global markets

values.name: Creating sustainable businesses
